title: Wach Nyasaye Ji Pok Ong`eyo
author: Traditional
content:
{title: Wach Nyasaye Ji Pok Ong`eyo}

{comment: Verse 1}
Wach  Nyasaye ji pok ong`eyo maber,
Jomoko paro ni ok owinj alam joge.
Jomoko paro ni ok onyal dwoko wach
Jomoko paro ni ok onyal dwoko wach

{comment: Verse 2}
Kilamo Yesu ni gima chando chunyi
Enowinji kaka nowinjo Elija 
Nyasae ong`uon owinjo joge moyie
Nyasae ong`uon owinjo joge moyie

{comment: Verse 3}
Nyasaye owacho ni joge duto moyie,
Temauru ana winju e lamo
Kitimo  chikna to ana konyu e lweny
Kitimo  chikna to ana konyu e lweny

{comment: Verse 4}
Teko gi gweth to Ruodha Yesu nigo,
Mwandu maduong` Ruodhwa Yesu nigo,
Omiyo joge matimo gi modwaro
Omiyo joge matimo gi modwaro
